Job description:
We are hiring an Artificial Intelligence content production and editing expert. We are looking for a creative, responsible, and eager-to-learn individual to collaborate in the field of AI-based content production. Required conditions and skills: Proficiency in AI tools such as Kling, ChatGPT, and Gemini for image, animation, and content generation; proficiency in video editing and editing software for preparing and presenting final outputs; ability to work in a team, effective interaction with team members, and willingness to learn, professional growth, and keeping specialized knowledge up-to-date. Benefits: Salary and benefits according to market customs and based on capability and experience, Social Security insurance, Eid and annual leave according to labor law, performance-based reward system, flexible working hours (start time between 8 AM and 10 AM). Working hours: Workdays: Saturday to Wednesday, Friday: If you are interested in the field of artificial intelligence, content production, and creating creative projects, we would be happy to receive your resume.

Company description:
We are a media cultural institution (Shariati-Mirdamad) where we spend our days on ideation, writing, visualization, editing, and lots of other creative work. To make our team more cohesive and stronger, we need a few fresh colleagues.
